title: Chapter 1454 - 5: The Fourth Path To Transcendence

Chapter 1454 - 5: The Fourth Path To Transcendence

Chapter 1454 - 5: The Fourth Path to Transcendence

"The power that shakes the entire endless dimension... even the will of the Supreme Rule Dao is retreating...

"Transcendence, it must be related to transcendence."

"No wonder I couldn't observe the current timeline over a hundred thousand years ago, so that's how it is, that's how it is."

One by one, the ancient Legendary Lords appeared, and those who roamed the past and future quickly returned to this time and space, sensing the strange force that penetrated the vast dimensions.

Rustle.

As time and space distorted, a twelve-armed figure appeared, looking up at the source of the strange vibrations.

At this moment, that place was in a state of absolute chaos, with an inexplicable force spreading and diffusing.

"Fantian, you've returned as well."

Not far from the twelve-armed figure, another figure condensed, its form changing at every moment, as if replicating everything in the endless dimensions.

"Wan Xiang, what do you think this power is?"

The twelve-armed figure, Fantian Lord, asked casually.

If there were other Legendary Lords present, they would be shocked to discover that both Fantian Lord and Lord Wan Xiang are incredibly ancient and powerful Legendary Lords.

Long before countless ages, they were already acknowledged as terrifying beings who had passed the three-hundred-millionth tribulation of their final stage, nearing the end of the path of transcendence.

"Related to transcendence, how would I know exactly what power it is?"

Lord Wan Xiang said, a hint of longing in his gaze.

Wasn't the pursuit of such power the very reason he traveled through the ancient past and distant future?

Buzz- At this moment, another figure gathered.

"Haotian."

Lord Wan Xiang glanced at the third figure, his expression showing caution.

Fantian Lord and Lord Haotian were known as the "Twin Heavens" among the many Legendary Lords, and their fame stretched across many time-space continuums both past and future.

As time passed.

One figure after another appeared, this being the location closest to the source of the strange vibrations, where only Legendary Lords nearby the three-hundred-millionth tribulation or close might stand. "The Sage has arrived."

Suddenly, a figure condensed, drawing the attention of many Legendary Lords.

"The Sage?"

Even Fantian Lord, Lord Haotian, and other Legendary Lords fixed their eyes on the last arriving figure.

"The Sage" was not the most powerful of Legendary Lords, having only passed the two-hundred-sixtieth millionth tribulation of their final

stage.

Unable to compare with beings like Lord Haotian or Fantian Lord.

Yet the years experienced by "The Sage" were undoubtedly the most ancient among all Legendary Lords.

It is said that shortly after this endless dimension was created, the Sage was born.

Legendary Lords from the same era as "The Sage" have mostly perished on some path of transcendence.

This is because The Sage never undertakes anything without

assurance.

In exploring the "infinite tribulations," too, he never attempts to cross without certainty.

And having experienced such a long, ancient time, he knows secrets vast as the sea of knowledge, thus earning the title of "The Sage." Though Legendary Lords can observe the timelines of past and future, many secrets, especially those related to transcendence, cannot be seen on the timeline; they must be personally experienced.

"The Sage." Lord Wan Xiang spoke: "What do you think is the cause of this transcendence-level power's appearance?"

"The cause?" The Sage quietly stared at the source of the strange vibrations, not directly answering, "I remember when I had just become a Lord, a major event occurred in the endless dimensions."

"When you first became a Lord?"

"A major event?"

The Legendary Lords became curious.

When The Sage had just become a Lord? How many ancient ages ago could that have been?

"At that time, I was still very weak, it was 'Wu You' Lord who shook the vast dimensions, reaching the pinnacle of lordship, striving towards the Fourteenth Rank, the evolution into a Perfect Time Being."

"The transition from imperfect to perfect, such a leap in life essence induced a tremor throughout the dimension. Although 'Wu You' Lord eventually failed, subsequent lords understood that the Perfect Time Being is the pinnacle for us Lords, and from then on, the Perfect Time Being became a path of transcendence."

The Sage's tone held a trace of nostalgia.

The path of transcendence to become a Perfect Time Being, unlike 'Infinite Origin' or 'Infinite Tribulations,' was one explored personally

by Lords.

"Are you suggesting that this power might evolve into a new path of transcendence?"

For the first time, Lord Haotian spoke.

Over the long eras, many paths of transcendence have existed, but

only three are mainstream and recognized by the majority of Lords.

Perfect Time Being.

Infinite Origin.

Infinite Tribulations.

"Indeed."

"Such a scene that shakes the entire dimension has only occurred

once before, during the first transition from imperfect to perfect..."

The Sage nodded, then added, "But this is just my speculation; I can't

be certain."

"Let's wait."

"Whether it is the fourth path of transcendence or not, we'll know if

we wait and see."

Fantian Lord spoke.

Upon hearing this, the other Legendary Lords suppressed their inner restlessness and began to wait patiently.

Soon enough.

Under the watchful gaze of all Legendary Lords.

The source of the strange vibrations suddenly began to "burst," with

strands of energy cascading into the endless dimensions. Each strand transformed as it descended, forming step after step of

white jade stairs.

The lower end of the white jade stairs connected to the endless dimension, while the upper end? It was seemingly endless, leading upwards as if reaching the eternal heights.
